name: Sakuragawa (Japan, city)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sakuragawa city emblem in pink, blue and navy: a pink cherry blossom above blue and navy waves.
history: Municipal flag of Sakuragawa, a city in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 2005.

features.role: Sakuragawa city emblem — a pink cherry blossom above blue and navy waves
